sources.entry: Answer - Knowledge-based community software. You can use it to quickly build your Q&A community for product technical support, customer support, user communication, and more. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Apache Answer is a self-hostable Q&A platform for community forums, help centers, and knowledge management.
summary.what_it_does: Apache Answer is a Q&A platform intended for teams of any size, per its README. The README positions it for community forums, help centers, and knowledge management platforms. It can be run quickly with a single Docker command that maps port 9080 to the container and stores data in a volume. The project provides a plugin system so developers can build custom plugins that extend its features. The README also describes building from source with Go, Node.js, and pnpm, using make targets to generate code and build the UI and backend. The source is licensed under Apache 2.0.
how_to_run: For building from source: install Golang >= 1.25, Node.js >= 20, pnpm >= 9, mockgen >= 0.6.0, and wire >= 0.5.0
notable: Single Docker command quick start with persistent data volume
Targets teams of any scale, including help centers and knowledge management
Apache License 2.0 with Apache Software Foundation project home
caveats: README does not describe feature details beyond the general purpose, so specifics must be checked in the project docs
Building from source requires several toolchain versions (Go 1.25+, Node 20+, pnpm 9+)
